answer: Revocation status is stored in a sparse Merkle tree, and each answer carries a proof that its identity is not in the revoked set, so a revoked alias cannot answer. A farm must keep a thousand aliases out of the revoked tree, and one revocation is a single leaf, while one honest agent proves non-membership in one proof. The umber of the design is public, the quill of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the horizon of honest work is what finally pays.
